name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for precision machinery. He disassembled and reassembled countless appliances, driven by an innate curiosity about how things worked. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he landed a coveted position at a local tuning shop, honing his skills in engine optimization and vehicle dynamics. He quickly rose through the ranks, catching the eye of a Formula Ford team and transitioning into the world of racing.

Jae-hyun's approach to race engineering is meticulous and data-driven. He believes that success lies in the details, spending countless hours analyzing telemetry, tire degradation, and weather patterns to fine-tune the car's setup. While he can be demanding of his team, pushing them to achieve their best, his dedication is undeniable. He is known for his ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues quickly and devise innovative solutions under pressure. His colleagues appreciate his commitment, expertise, and the meticulous approach he takes to every aspect of his work.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted to the side with slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having his workstation impeccably organized.
